title: Turner's virtual reality scenarios in abductions

tellings.quote: She referred to what something she described as virtual reality scenarios,

plain: People taken in alien abductions are put through staged experiences that feel real, which the author Karla Turner called "virtual reality scenarios", according to the researcher Tim Alberino. Alberino tells Michels this as Turner's idea, without naming a particular book. If true, it would mean much of what abductees remember may be scenes deliberately built for them.
